lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to the World 20 Grand Festival! This is our 600th lesson! We finished Stage 2. Let's start the show with our big sentence. Thank you for coming to our festival! Say it with me. Thank you for coming to our festival! Fantastic! In Stage 2, you learned so much. She plays the drums. I'm dancing now. Yesterday, I swam. Next year, I'm going to learn more. The island is more exciting than the market. You have to stay with your group. Would you like to dance with us? Make yourself at home. Thank you for having me. Why don't we sing together? Shall we? ステージ2 クリア！600 かい、ほんとうに よく がんばったね。 Phonics review. Picture. Year. Cheer. Festival. Celebration. Dancing. You were brave travelers and great friends. Now, look at the sky. Fireworks! Let's dance together!
